modules.name: Mechanical structure and enclosure
modules.purpose: The printable and editable body of the reference machine.
modules.existing: STEP case files, STL structure, and a photographed assembly of the finished enclosure.
modules.missing: Shared mounting dimensions for lab-specific panels and product bays.
modules.contribution: Propose a mounting interface without replacing the Version Zero files in place.
modules.next_milestone: A drafted interface note another lab can machine against.

modules.name: Dispensing mechanisms
modules.purpose: Release a product after the backend authorizes the card.
modules.existing: Four-column dispenser, servo-driven arms, and recorded direct and balance dispenses.
modules.missing: Tested mechanisms for product sizes the reference columns do not fit.
modules.contribution: Design a replacement dispenser with part id, CAD, compatibility, and a dispense test.
modules.next_milestone: One reviewed alternative dispenser that does not overwrite Version Zero.

modules.name: Electronics and control
modules.purpose: Sense a card, drive the servos, and talk to the backend.
modules.existing: Two Wio Terminals, Feetech ST3215 bus servos, and an RFID reader. XIAO is not the controller.
modules.missing: Any later control redesign, which would be a new version rather than a silent swap.
modules.contribution: Document a control change against the current wiring before proposing it as current.
modules.next_milestone: A short electrical interface note for the reference build.

modules.name: Firmware and backend software
modules.purpose: Authorize a card, plan the dispense, and record the result.
modules.existing: Wio firmware, bring-up sketches, and a Node.js backend with Operate, Inventory, and Config.
modules.missing: A written software contract for a lab that changes the mechanism or the product map.
modules.contribution: Improve the operator software against a stated acceptance check.
modules.next_milestone: A documented API note for card verify, checkout, and dispense complete.

modules.name: Machine operation and inventory
modules.purpose: Let an operator see columns, refill them, and issue cards.
modules.existing: Inventory counts, refill state, and card writing on the reference dashboard.
modules.missing: A restock routine and reliability log meant for more than one machine.
modules.contribution: Run repeated dispense trials and publish what failed.
modules.next_milestone: A failure and refill note from a real operating stretch.

modules.name: Product compatibility and XIAO offering
modules.purpose: Say what the machine can hold, and what a shared default product might be.
modules.existing: The reference columns exist. XIAO is named as the intended default product category, not as stock in a machine.
modules.missing: Product envelopes, a merchandising concept, and any confirmed supply.
modules.contribution: Define a product module with dimensions and a source model.
modules.next_milestone: A dimension note for one real product the reference column can carry.

modules.name: Fab Lab deployment and support
modules.purpose: Turn one build into something another lab can stand up and, later, apply to join.
modules.existing: A single-machine assembly guide, bill of materials, and backend start script.
modules.missing: Pilot criteria, a support model, and deployment notes that assume a different room and network.
modules.contribution: Write the steps a second lab still has to invent.
modules.next_milestone: A deployment checklist reviewed against the reference build.

modules.name: Community infrastructure
modules.purpose: Take lab submissions in public and publish only what a person has checked.
modules.existing: This site and GitHub Issue Forms. Pages cannot store a private submission by itself.
modules.missing: Reviewed lab records, machine photos, and any later backend that replaces the issue queue.
modules.contribution: Register interest, or maintain the JSON after a review.
modules.next_milestone: The first reviewed lab record, if a lab submits one.

modules.name: Standards and verification
modules.purpose: Agree on identifiers, interfaces, and the checks required before a part or a listing is current.
modules.existing: Part ids in the Version Zero manifest, and a rule that replacements are appended.
modules.missing: Every proposed standard. None is accepted.
modules.contribution: Draft an interface or documentation rule and mark it as an idea.
modules.next_milestone: One written draft, still labeled idea or draft, not accepted.

contributions.title: Improve the dispensing mechanism
contributions.problem: The reference dispenser fits one product geometry. Other packages jam, rattle, or do not fit.
contributions.expected_output: A versioned dispenser replacement: part id, source CAD, what it replaces, and a short dispense test.
contributions.acceptance: Version Zero files stay unchanged. The note states compatibility and includes test evidence.

contributions.title: Design a new product module
contributions.problem: Labs need a way to describe a local product the machine can hold, separate from open-sourcing that product.
contributions.expected_output: Part id, source CAD or dimension drawing, version, purpose, and compatibility assumptions.
contributions.acceptance: The submission distinguishes an alternative part from a new revision and names the license of the CAD.

contributions.title: Test machine reliability
contributions.problem: The repository shows that dispensing works. It does not publish a repeated trial or a failure log.
contributions.expected_output: A test note: cycle count, what failed, and what was changed.
contributions.acceptance: The note is tied to a machine version and does not claim a safety certification.

contributions.title: Improve the operator software
contributions.problem: A lab operator needs the dashboard to stay understandable when the catalog or the columns change.
contributions.expected_output: A code change or a written defect with the page, the expected result, and how to reproduce it.
contributions.acceptance: Operate, Inventory, and Config still run, and the change is described in the pull request.

contributions.title: Create deployment documentation
contributions.problem: The assembly guide builds one machine. It does not yet brief a different lab on room, power, and handoff.
contributions.expected_output: A checklist another lab can follow, with gaps marked instead of invented steps.
contributions.acceptance: Every step points at a file in the repository or is labeled as local judgment.

contributions.title: Define common interfaces
contributions.problem: Modules can be replaced in principle. The mounting, electrical, and software boundaries are not written down as a draft.
contributions.expected_output: A draft, labeled as an idea, covering one interface: mechanical, electrical, or software.
contributions.acceptance: The text is not described as an approved or industry standard.
